scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler --config api/wrangler.toml d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler --config api/wrangler.toml d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.baseten:check: test -f api/.dev.vars && grep -q '^BASETEN_API_URL=https\?://' api/.dev.vars && grep -q '^BASETEN_API_KEY=...' api/.dev.vars && echo 'baseten dev wiring: present' || (echo 'baseten dev wiring: missing (run ./baseten/link-dev.sh <model-id>)' >&2; exit 1)
scripts.modal:check: test -f api/.dev.vars && grep -q '^MODAL_API_URL=https\?://' api/.dev.vars && grep -q '^MODAL_PROXY_TOKEN=..*' api/.dev.vars && echo 'modal dev wiring: present' || (echo 'modal dev wiring: missing (see modal/README.md)' >&2; exit 1)
